description: This file defines a database driver class for connecting and interacting with SAP Adaptive Server Enterprise (Sybase ASE) databases within the ADOdb PHP library. It includes methods for retrieving metadata about databases, tables, and columns, as well as handling error messages, and extending functionality through subclasses.

classes.name: ADODB_sybase_ase
classes.description: Database driver class for SAP Adaptive Server Enterprise, extending the base Sybase driver with specific SQL queries and metadata retrieval methods.

classes.name: adorecordset_sybase_ase
classes.description: Recordset class for handling result sets from Sybase ASE queries.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of table or view names from the database, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Retrieves a list of database names from the server.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns of a specified table.

methods.name: getProcedureList
methods.description: Stub method that returns false; intended to list stored procedures.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns error message, checking for the presence of the 'sybase_connect' PHP function.
